content.text:
I fixed this in `unwrapMdxCodeBlocks` (`packages/docusaurus-utils/src/markdownUtils.ts:72-75`). Its pattern looked only for LF line breaks (`\n`) around the ` ```mdx-code-block ` fence. With CRLF line endings the stray `\r` stopped the pattern from matching, so the block was never unwrapped. The `import Tabs/TabItem` lines then stayed inside a plain code block and never ran, which is why the build reported `TabItem` as undefined.

The fix lets both the 3-backtick and 4-backtick patterns accept `\r?\n` at every line break. I ran the function on a CRLF ` ```mdx-code-block ` sample with an import inside, and it now unwraps correctly. The existing `markdownUtils` tests still pass (92/92). I didn't add a new test.

One caveat: I couldn't see the issue's screenshot. I'm assuming the content uses the common pattern of wrapping the Tabs imports in ` ```mdx-code-block `, since that's the only line-ending-sensitive code on this path that matches the symptom. If the content imports Tabs at the top level instead, this change won't affect it.
